visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler with short brown hair sits in a restaurant high chair, wearing a yellow bib with a cartoon pattern; he opens his mouth wide in a joyful laugh while a yellow toy sits on the table. (2) The scene shifts to various quick cuts of the child being held by a woman in a denim jacket in a clothing store, then at home, and in a stadium setting with other people in the background. (3) The toddler is shown in a living room, wearing a denim jacket and holding an orange egg-shaped toy, looking curious. (4) A woman pushes a stroller outdoors; the child inside is wearing a blue fuzzy 'Monsters Inc.' Sully costume and laughing heartily. (5) Transition to a skincare demonstration where a woman with long dark hair and a black shirt applies clear serum and white cream from Avène bottles to her face in a well-lit indoor setting. (6) Close-up shots of the product packaging (Avène Hyaluron Activ B3) are interspersed with her applying the product to her cheeks and around her eyes. (7) The final sequence shows the woman walking with the child on a sunny pier at sunset, followed by a group shot of two women and the child posing in front of a pink house in a desert landscape.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, melodic piano track serving as a bed for a calm, professional female voiceover in Mandarin; the voice has a friendly and reflective tone. (2) A subtle whoosh sound effect punctuates a visual transition as the narrator begins discussing the challenges and rewards of motherhood. (3) During the skincare product demonstration, the narration becomes more informative and descriptive, detailing product benefits while a light acoustic guitar layer joins the piano. (4) The track maintains a consistent positive valence with high spectral clarity, concluding with a warm closing statement as the music softly fades.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook (Motherhood questions) -> Emotional Montage -> Product Solution (Avène) -> Conclusion (Love self and family)
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video combines personal lifestyle storytelling about the joys and challenges of raising a child with a commercial endorsement for Avène skincare products. It aims to resonate with young mothers by showing that caring for one's skin is a vital part of 'loving oneself' while being a parent.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed product demonstration, close-ups of packaging, on-screen branding, and verbal endorsement of product efficacy.
